outcome: Early neonatal brain damage findings (cranial USG)
cohort: The study included 115 neonates (50 term and 65 preterm) born in Zeynep Kamil Maternity and Children Hospital.
finding: The study could not demonstrate early neonatal brain injury pathologic findings associated with HCA using cranial USG, and abnormal cranial USG findings in the preterm group were attributed to prematurity independent of chorioamnionitis and PROM.
cross-section timing: Cranial USG imaging performed at 11.9 ± 10.4 days in term neonates and 9.1 ± 7.7 days in preterm neonates.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 39 GW for term neonates and 33.8 ± 1.3 GW for preterm neonates.
